Triage 2026-10-19 at 9fdbbbcf, DUPLICATE (3-skeptic check 3/3 upheld): The defect is still present at HEAD 9fdbbbcf. In crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/backend.rs:254-264, `TasksBackend::update_task_per_user` still has a default body, `self.update_object::<jmap_tasks_types::Task>(caller, account_id, id, patch)`. Its rustdoc at backend.rs:238-242 still says only that multi-user backends "SHOULD override", even though draft-tasks-06 section 4.5.1 says the shared `updated` timestamp MUST NOT change. The routing code at task.rs:353 calls it, and MockBackend overrides it at lib.rs:508. memory.rs does not override it (it only mentions it in a doc comment at memory.rs:21), so the reference MemoryBackend uses the default.

An earlier bead covers exactly this: JMAP-h47t.15 (OPEN, created 2026-05-14, three days before this one). Its title is "TasksBackend::update_task_per_user default delegates to update_object — multi-user backends that forget to override silently viola
